notes: Company background: Peregrine builds an enterprise IDE copilot focused on monorepo-aware completions and code-search. Customers: mid-market dev teams, internal dev platform use.

Initial interest: low-latency streaming completions inside VS Code plugin + repo-aware context retrieval. Must pin models per-customer and guarantee predictable latency under 100ms median for completions.
Technical constraints: customer data residency required for EU clients; product wants VPC/private deployment for enterprise customers. Also exploring on-prem option for banking pilot.

Retrieval architecture discussed: embeddings + vector DB (preference for self-hosted Milvus or hosted Dedicated vector nodes). Need control over chunking strategy (file-level + function-level embeddings) and incremental indexing.

Embedding model preferences: support for open models (e.g., Llama2 embeddings variants) and ability to swap to Redwood-verified small embeddings to save cost. Must support version pinning and rollback on model regressions.
POC scope agreed: ingest 3 repos (~50GB code), verify recall on code search, measure end-to-end latency for single-token streaming completions, evaluate prefix KV caching impact.
Security asks: SSO (SAML), SOC2 + ISO27001 certificates, audit logs for token usage, customer-managed KMS for keys, retention controls configurable per-namespace.
Cost sensitivity: embedding compute and vector storage are primary cost concerns; request recommendations from Redwood Optimize on batching and quantization for their workload.
